verdict.rationale: The Radeon RX 9070 XT is a discrete graphics card with a local driver and compute stack (ROCm). It has no hosted service, account system, or API that issues credentials, so scoped agent API credentials are a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows any credential-issuance feature that would make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
